comparison.objective: Replace a served beer after detecting a wasp and customer reaction; not tune mechanical damping.
comparison.physical_skill: Social-state interpretation, glass transport, tap operation, and undoing completed work versus precision maintenance tooling and iterative impact evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Contaminated glass removed and a clean replacement served versus two repeatable, non-bottoming, locked carriage stops.
comparison.reason: Both involve revising an action after observation only at a very generic level. Detailed scoring, spill limits, and spec versions are absent.
